name: version-entitlement
lines: I'm demo customer 111. Playback 8.6.2 on my iPad says Cloud Pro expired. Can you check whether my demo subscription is active and whether a newer version has a documented fix?
expect: Use the simulated customer lookup and installed-version comparison as relevant. The comparison already retrieves current App Store metadata; a separate current-version call is unnecessary. Distinguish bounded release history from live current-version metadata, and avoid claiming a real customer account was verified.
